claims.statement: The fragment opens Copilot in the sidebar. Its view-policy filename does not supply actual policy values, effective enablement, licensing or verified access; no policy was read from a live enterprise or changed.

The fragment optionally opens current organization configurations before a setting change and describes coverage of all enterprise organizations. This is a UI affordance and recommendation, not an actual complete configuration inventory, approved plan, saved change or verified inheritance. The screenshot image was not inspected.
The fragment opens MCP in the sidebar. It supplies no registry restrictions, server allowlist, client support, tool trust, configured policy or enforcement proof; no MCP settings changed.

The described dormant-user list excludes suspended users and site administrators. Its word all is limited to unsuspended, non-site-administrator dormant users, not a full estate user inventory or all dormant identities. No account activity, suspension, deletion or license recovery was verified.

The fragment describes a combined Microsoft subscriber offering for Visual Studio and GitHub Enterprise. It supplies no current price, qualifying subscriber identity, allocated seat, full product scope or per-file content redistribution rights; no subscription or entitlement was verified.
